title: Apple Store With All-New Design Opening Soon in Southern California
content:
Apple today announced that its retail store at The Forum in Carlsbad, California will be reopening in its original location on Friday, November 20 at 10 a.m. local time, following more than a year of renovations. Additions will likely include a Genius Bar with accessible seating and a dedicated Apple Pickup area for online orders.

Apple's temporary store in Carlsbad

Apple's temporary store at The Forum will be permanently closed, with the company set to return to its original 2008 unit at the shopping plaza.

Carlsbad is a coastal beach city in the North County area of San Diego County.
